applies_to: Daikin Altherma 3 air-to-water heat pumps, connected on the P1/P2 user-interface bus.
summary: Intesis interface for one Daikin Altherma 3 air-to-water heat pump on the P1/P2 bus, speaking BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU (Modbus is the factory setting). It exposes 100 objects for zone on/off and heat/cool mode, zone 1 and room 1 setpoints with their limits, DHW tank control, water and refrigerant temperatures, compressor and pump run times, flow and pressure.
notes: The manual's object table has no read/write column. Access is inferred: AO/BO/MO command objects as commandable, inputs as read-only.
Footnote numbers printed after some object names in the table (for example DIP_SW_1_status2) are not part of the name and were removed.
DHWTempSetpointappliedUpLimit_status is printed with a lower-case 'a'; kept as printed.
Room1Antifrost_status lists its states as '0: 0ff, 1: On' in the manual (typo for Off).
Temperatures follow the °C/°F setting on DIP switch SW2 position 8.

source.title: IN485DAI001A000 User Manual - Daikin Altherma 3 Air-to-water Heat Pumps to BACnet MS/TP and Modbus RTU

integration.summary: Connect the gateway to the Altherma P1/P2 bus and the EIA-485 network, then set SW1 position 5 OFF: the gateway ships set for Modbus RTU. Start/stop space heating or cooling with ZonesOnOff_command, pick heat or cool with ZonesMode_command, and write zone 1, room 1 and DHW setpoints to their _command objects.
integration.enable: SW1 position 5 must be OFF for BACnet MS/TP (ON = Modbus RTU, the default). BO 3 RemoteControlLock_command = 1 lets only the BMS control the unit; commands from the Daikin remote are then ignored.
integration.remote_sensors: Write a BMS room temperature to AO 15 Room1TempBACnetRoomThermAmbientRef_command. Once a valid value is written, the gateway's Virtual Temperature function uses it to offset the setpoint so the living area reaches the requested temperature.
setup: SW1 P5: OFF = BACnet MS/TP, ON = Modbus RTU (default); SW1 P6-P8 baud rate, autobaud by default.
MS/TP MAC address on SW2 P1-P7; SW2 P8 selects °C (default) or °F.
Default device instance 246000; in automatic mode it is 246000 + the MAC address. Writing Object_Identifier switches to manual addressing until a factory reset.
SW3 enables the 120-ohm terminator and bus biasing.
DIP switch changes take effect after a reboot.
gotchas: Write the _command object and read the matching _status object; they have different object types and instance numbers.
Custom setpoint limits cannot go past the unit's own limits (the Unit...Limit objects); the Applied...Limit objects show the range in force.
Several Altherma units on one gateway act as one unit.
